mcpTools.name: health
mcpTools.description: Reports repository-context reachability and retrieval readiness.

mcpTools.name: recall
mcpTools.description: Fetches one repository-context record by its full key.

mcpTools.name: scan
mcpTools.description: Walks an ordered, paged range of repository-context entries.

mcpTools.name: list_topics
mcpTools.description: Enumerates a repository's agent-memory topics with live entry counts.

mcpTools.name: search
mcpTools.description: Ranks repository-context records against a natural-language query.

mcpTools.name: index_status
mcpTools.description: Reports the progress of a repository's indexing job.

mcpTools.name: neighbors
mcpTools.description: Walks the typed knowledge-linking edges out of a memory entry.

mcpTools.name: outline
mcpTools.description: Returns the declared-symbol skeleton of one indexed file.

mcpTools.name: related
mcpTools.description: Resolves a file's imports, dependents and covering tests.

mcpTools.name: context
mcpTools.description: Packs a ranked, explained source bundle under a hard token ceiling.

mcpTools.name: stats
mcpTools.description: Summarises the repository-context surface's own recent token usage.

mcpTools.name: claim_status
mcpTools.description: Reports the claim recorded on a memory record and its lock status.
